correctness.rationale: The unique complex rational elliptic fibration has I6,I3,I2,I1 fibres and six torsion sections; adjunction with K=-F restricts negative curves to six disjoint (-1)-sections and the 11 (-2)-components of the three reducible fibres. Section/fibre incidence follows torsion component labels j mod n and the Shioda height equations. Independently constructed the 17x17 negative intersection matrix, including the double intersection between I2 components. Checked every one of 131072 subsets by hereditary negative-definiteness and numerically independent eigenvalue tests: counts by sizes (1,17,135,637,1929,3852,5039,4111,1836,296), total 17853. Exactly 72 minimally bad supports, all singular, and torsion translation partitions them into 3 fixed, one orbit of length 3, and 11 orbits of length 6. The finite census is exhaustive conditional on the proven geometric inventory; independent eigenvalues corroborate but are not a formal exact determinant certificate.

value.rationale: The extremal six-torsion surface is a canonical object with sharply constrained negative curve geometry. Its full intersection-theoretic obstruction classification and torsion orbits give an exact natural chamber invariant beyond a generic counting algorithm; the 296 maximal supports can be used as a complete combinatorial test case.
